Actual Sonnet 18.53 Lite controls captured on 2026-10-04 establish that POLY id 0 selects every logical polygon vertex, excluding the closing duplicate. Sixteen NSCD ANC/RAD controls cover both axes, both directions and expansion/contraction. Native zero-count selectors, explicit all-vertex lists and independent sequential literals have identical full matrices. Public raw solves pass the unchanged 0.005 full-S and 1e-9 original voltage-residual gates at mx=my=128; measured maxima are 1.90278765543e-05 and 2.11630095768e-11.

Initial four-mode controls retain competing whole-once, reference-only and double-reference hypotheses. NSCD/RAD match double-reference literals; SCUNI/SCXY reference scaling hypotheses do not match and remain guarded. Multiple explicit reference occurrences and dependent/overlapping dimensions remain outside the established adapter.

The pre-change public gate ran at commit 5c7f31eb3341b8a5acba7d804910328dfa6cda81 and rejected both native-accepted whole-polygon selectors. Independent literal solves passed before implementation. Raw source, matrices, logs, metadata, source-stability hashes and exact producer/template bytes are retained without rewriting capture paths. Expanded logical vertices consume the point budget and additional storage reserve before their lists are allocated. Warmed cumulative returned-geometry allocations are not peak process memory.

Replay the sixteen native triples with validation/planar_audit/run_whole_geovar_reference.jl. Historical producers may refer to their original ignored data inputs and are retained as capture provenance. Every payload has a SHA256 entry.
